gold_sql:
SELECT p.*, elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.88824 35.992246)',4326)::geography, 5000)
  AND p.amenity = 'cafe'
  AND elev.z >= 140;

WITH cafe_point AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.976492 39.962826)'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
gardens_point AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.88824 35.992246)'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
buffered_area AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Buffer(gardens_point.geom, 5000) AS geom
  FROM 
    gardens_point
),
raster_clip AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(rast, buffered_area.geom)
),
elevation_values AS (
  SELECT 
    (ST_SummaryStats(ST_Clip(raster_clip.rast, 1, buffered_area.geom, TRUE))).*
  FROM 
    raster_clip, buffered_area
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN mean >= 140 THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS has_suitable_elevation;
